train_HalideModel: train a Halide neural rewriter model on a dataset with configurable epochs and batch size
evaluate_HalideModel: evaluate a trained Halide model on a test dataset and print loss and reward metrics
create_model_HalideSupervisor: create a HalideModel with a HalideSupervisor optionally loading pretrained weights or resuming training
run_Halide_training_cli: run the Halide training script via CLI with argparse to train or evaluate a model
review_train_function: review the train function that handles batching, evaluation checkpoints, learning rate decay, and model saving
